title: OpenCode HTTP/SSE native session lifecycle
description: Evidence-qualified partial order for the pinned OpenCode 1.18.16 serve backend. Repeated status and part updates are native loops, and blocker branches remain distinct from normalized turn state.
source: Hermetic OpenCode HTTP/SSE census and exact-session native attach probe documented in packages/surface/vendors/opencode/findings.md.

nodes.label: permission.replied · native attach after restart
nodes.description: After the private backend restarted and recovered the exact session, a newly attached native TUI resolved the resumed turn's permission with always; the harness issued no permission reply request.

nodes.label: POST /session/:id/fork
nodes.description: With messageID, clones history strictly before the target; without a body, clones the complete history. Both allocate new message and part IDs.

nodes.label: session.created · independent fork
nodes.description: The fork has a new root session ID and no parentID; cloned assistant parentID values are remapped to cloned user message IDs.

nodes.label: session.updated · archived timestamp
nodes.description: The update response and live event carry the same archived timestamp.

nodes.label: GET /session · archived retained
nodes.description: The stable project-scoped list retains archived sessions.

nodes.label: GET /experimental/session · archived excluded
nodes.description: Without archived=true, the experimental global list excludes archived sessions.

nodes.label: GET /experimental/session · archived=true
nodes.description: With archived=true, the experimental global list includes active and archived sessions.

nodes.label: session.deleted
nodes.description: Carries the deleted session snapshot; the next archived-inclusive list no longer returns that ID.

nodes.label: message.part.updated · prompt file
nodes.description: A text/plain prompt attachment persists as a file part after OpenCode emits two synthetic text expansions for the read call and decoded contents.

nodes.label: step-start · pre-mutation snapshot
nodes.description: The step-start part carries the snapshot hash later repeated as the patch-part hash.

nodes.label: step-finish · post-mutation snapshot
nodes.description: The step-finish snapshot differs from the pre-mutation snapshot for the controlled file change.

nodes.label: GET /session/:id/diff · messageID
nodes.description: With the exact submitted messageID query, returns the snapshot-derived per-message diff; without it, the endpoint returns an empty array.

nodes.label: GET /vcs/diff · git
nodes.description: Returns the current tracked workspace patch; the message-scoped session diff is a separate snapshot-derived view.

nodes.label: step-finish · 120 tokens / 128 context
nodes.description: Controlled reported usage crossed the 96-token usable threshold after reserving 32 output tokens.

nodes.label: session.error · provider context overflow
nodes.description: A controlled provider HTTP 413 was parsed as ContextOverflowError; automatic compaction continued instead of terminating the session.

nodes.label: step-finish · unknown capacity / high usage
nodes.description: With model limit.context=0, reported total usage of 1,000,010 completed normally without a compaction part or session.compacted event.

nodes.label: session.created · child
nodes.description: Child session has info.parentID joined to the parent session and is also returned by GET /session/:id/children.

nodes.label: session.idle · child
nodes.description: The session ID is the child ID carried by the parent task tool metadata.

nodes.label: task tool · background handle returned
nodes.description: The parent task carrier is completed with background:true and jobId equal to the child session ID while the child is still running.
Carries both terminal provider errors and MessageAbortedError observations; privacy redaction prevents a false stable match selector on prose error names.
